verses.pali: Yo ca āpattiyā āpattisaññī, yo ca anāpattiyā anāpattisaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives an offense as an offense, and one who perceives a non-offense as a non-offense.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā na vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements don’t grow.”
